l1.title: Otu sel si emepụta ume
l1.summary: Mitochondria na-agbanwe glucose na oxygen ka ọ ghọọ ATP, ego ume nke sel ọ bụla na-emefu.
keyPoints: Anaerobic respiration na-emepụta lactic acid n’ime akwara

l2.title: Jenetiks mere ka ọ dị mfe: dominant na recessive
l2.summary: Ihe mere i nwere ike inwe anya nne gị mana ogologo nna nna gị: alleles, genotypes na Punnett squares.
keyPoints: Àgwà (trait) ọ bụla nwere alleles abụọ
Punnett squares na-ebu amụma ratio ụmụ a ga-amụ

l3.title: Usoro nri (food chain) na ọsọ ume
l3.summary: Ume na-esi n’aka ndị na-emepụta (producers) gaa n’aka ndị na-eri (consumers), ọ bụ naanị ihe dị ka 10% na-agafe gaa n’ọkwa ọ bụla na-esote.
keyPoints: Producers na-emepụta nri site na photosynthesis
Ihe dị ka 10% nke ume na-agafe n’ọkwa ọ bụla

l4.title: Echiche mole n’ime nkeji 5
l4.summary: Otu mole bụ particles 6.02 × 10²³. Mụta ịgbanwe n’etiti mass, moles na particles na ntụkwasị obi.
keyPoints: Jiri ratio sitere na balanced equations

l5.title: Ionic na covalent bonding
l5.summary: Ionic bonds na-enyefe electrons; covalent bonds na-ekerịta ha. Kaadị 20 iji mee ka ọ banye gị n’isi.
keyPoints: Ionic compounds na-eduba ọkụ eletrik mgbe ha gbazere (molten)

l6.title: Kemistrị organic: ịkpọ alkanes aha
l6.summary: Nwalee onwe gị n’ịkpọ aha IUPAC maka alkanes, alkenes na alcohols.
keyPoints: Malite ọnụọgụgụ site na nsọtụ kacha nso na alaka (branch)

l7.title: Iwu atọ Newton, a kọwara ha
l7.summary: Inertia, F = ma, na action–reaction, ya na ihe atụ kwa ụbọchị site na ụgbọ danfo ruo bọọlụ.
keyPoints: Ihe ga-anọ jụụ ma ọ bụrụ na ihe emetụghị ya
Action ọ bụla nwere reaction hà nhata ma chee ya ihu

l8.title: Iwu Ohm na circuit dị mfe
l8.summary: V = IR. Otu voltage, current na resistance si metụta onwe ha na circuit series na parallel.

l9.title: Ebili: frequency, wavelength, ọsọ
l9.summary: Ajụjụ iri dị ka nke ule na v = fλ.
keyPoints: Ụda chọrọ medium (ihe ọ ga-esi gafee)

l10.title: Idozi nhata quadratic
l10.summary: Factorisation, completing the square na formula. Họrọ ụzọ kacha ọsọ oge niile.
keyPoints: Discriminant na-agwa gị ole roots dị

l11.title: Trigonometrị: SOH CAH TOA
l11.summary: Ratio sine, cosine na tangent ya na aghụghọ ncheta na-anọgide n’isi.

l12.title: Statistiks: mean, median na mode
l12.summary: Ụzọ atọ isi kọwaa “etiti” data, na mgbe a ga-eji nke ọ bụla.
keyPoints: Mode: nke na-apụta ugboro ugboro karịa

l13.title: Differentiation site na first principles
l13.summary: Ihe derivative pụtara n’ezie, a na-ewuli ya nzọụkwụ nzọụkwụ.
keyPoints: Derivative bụ ọsọ mgbanwe (rate of change)

l14.title: Ide mmalite edemede siri ike
l14.summary: Hook, ọnọdụ, thesis: mmalite nwere akụkụ atọ nke ndị na-ahụ maka ule hụrụ n’anya.

l15.title: Ide nchịkọta na-enweta akara
l15.summary: Otu e si achọta isi ihe ma degharịa ha n’okwu nke gị, n’ime oke okwu e nyere.
keyPoints: Otu isi ihe n’ahịrịokwu ọ bụla

l16.title: Mmemme Lexis & structure
l16.summary: Synonyms, antonyms na sentence completion dị ka nke JAMB.
keyPoints: Buru ụzọ gụọ ahịrịokwu ahụ dum
Lezie anya maka ihe ngosi tense
Wepụ nhọrọ ndị doro anya na ha ezighi ezi

l17.title: Things Fall Apart: isiokwu (themes)
l17.summary: Mpako, omenala na mgbanwe n’akwụkwọ ama ama Achebe, dị ka ihe ọmụmụ ọdịyo ị nwere ike ige ebe ọ bụla.

l18.title: Ọchịchọ na ọnyịnye, n’ụzọ dị mfe
l18.summary: Ihe mere ọnụahịa ji arị elu ma na-agbada, jiri ahịa tomato mee ihe atụ.
keyPoints: Ọchịchọ (demand) na-ebelata ka ọnụahịa na-arị elu
Ọnyịnye (supply) na-arị elu ka ọnụahịa na-arị elu
Equilibrium bụ ebe ha abụọ zutere

l19.title: Inflation: ihe mere ọnụahịa ji na-arị elu mgbe niile
l19.summary: Ihe na-akpata ya, mmetụta ya na otu central banks si alụso inflation ọgụ.
keyPoints: Inflation na-ebelata ike ego ịzụ ihe (purchasing power)
Interest rates bụ isi ngwa ọrụ

l20.title: Double entry bookkeeping
l20.summary: Azụmahịa (transaction) ọ bụla nwere akụkụ abụọ. Debits, credits na accounting equation.
keyPoints: Debit ọ bụla nwere credit dabara ya

l21.title: Ngalaba ọchịchị
l21.summary: Legislature, executive na judiciary: onye na-eme gịnị.

l22.title: Nnwere onwe Naịjirịa n’oge 10 dị mkpa
l22.summary: Site na amalgamation nke 1914 ruo 1 October 1960.

l23.title: Ịgụ contour maps
l23.summary: Contours, spot heights na gradients, a kọwara ha.
keyPoints: Contours dị nso n’ibe ha = mkpọda dị elu (steep slope)
Ọdịdị V na-atụ aka n’isi mmiri (upstream)

l24.title: Mmemme Python mbụ gị
l24.summary: Variables, print na input: dee program ga-ekele gị n’aha gị.
keyPoints: input() na-agụ ihe onye ọrụ pịnyere

l25.title: Algorithm na ndụ kwa ụbọchị
l25.summary: Usoro isi nri, ntụziaka ụzọ na ịhazi playlist gị: algorithm dị ebe niile.
keyPoints: Algorithm ọma na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma n’efughị oge

l26.title: Gịnị bụ AI n’ezie?
l26.summary: Otu igwe si amụta patterns site na data, na ihe ha ka na-enweghị ike ime.
keyPoints: AI na-amụta patterns site n’ihe atụ

l27.title: Prompting dị ka ọkachamara
l27.summary: Nye ọnọdụ, kenye ya ọrụ (role) ma rịọ maka ụdị azịza: nweta azịza ka mma site n’aka AI.
keyPoints: Rịọ ka o chee echiche nzọụkwụ nzọụkwụ

l28.title: Ịkpụ ọnụahịa ngwaahịa mbụ gị
l28.summary: Cost-plus, value-based na competitor pricing maka ndị na-eto eto na-achụ ego.

Kpụọ ọnụahịa dabere n’uru, ọ bụghị naanị ego ị mefuru

l29.title: Ekele & mmeghe onwe gị na Frenchị
l29.summary: Bonjour, ça va? Kwuo ahịrịokwu Frenchị mbụ gị na ntụkwasị obi.

l31.title: Obi mmadụ na mgbasa ọbara

l31.summary: Ajụjụ iri na abụọ gbasara obi, akwara ọbara na double circulation.

l32.title: Jiometrị: akụkụ (angles) na okirikiri
l32.summary: Circle theorems ya na eserese ị ga-enwe ike ịgbaso n’ezie.
keyPoints: Angle na centre = 2 × angle na circumference
Angles nọ n’otu segment hà nhata
Angles chere ibe ha ihu na cyclic quad na-agbakọ ruo 180°
